lessons.title: The Adversary's Playbook 📖
lessons.description: Discover what anti‑forensics is, why attackers use it, and the cat‑and‑mouse game of investigations.

lessons.title: Encryption & Steganography: Hiding the Data 🔐
lessons.description: Understand how encryption, steganography, and hidden volumes can conceal evidence from prying eyes.

lessons.title: Trail Obfuscation: Timestomping & Log Tampering 🕰️
lessons.description: Learn how attackers manipulate timestamps, erase event logs, and wipe command histories to cover tracks.

lessons.title: Artifact Wiping & Secure Deletion 🧹
lessons.description: Explore how data is securely erased, free space wiped, and how SSDs complicate recovery.

lessons.title: Detection & Counter‑Countermeasures 🔍
lessons.description: Become the hunter – learn to spot anti‑forensics, recover from wiping, and beat the adversary.
